suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Free trial class
suggested_services.example: The main story: Mateo's free trial in Erin's Kids Beginner class, Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am. Nothing is taken and no card is saved: a YES books it, and nothing is owed after. A member's class books the same way (covered by the membership).

suggested_services.name: Private lesson (30 min)
suggested_services.example: A $55 private lesson for Mateo with Erin (30 minutes), paid in full when booking. Single classes ($25), belt tests ($40) and a membership's first month are paid this way too. A late cancel or a no-show: the $55 may be kept, only with Sam's OK.

suggested_services.name: Office self-defense class
suggested_services.example: The main story: a $179 self-defense class for up to 12 coworkers at Alex's office with Diego (60 minutes). A card is saved for the $89 late-cancel or no-show fee, and it's charged $179 when Diego texts DONE.

suggested_services.name: Office self-defense class
suggested_services.example: The same $179 class for a company, a school or a community center that pays by bill: nothing is taken to book, and Rosie texts the bill after.

suggested_services.name: Private lesson at home
suggested_services.example: A $150 private lesson at home with Diego (60 minutes), paid in full when booking. With a child, a parent stays home for the whole lesson.

before_times: new to the school, or trained here before (sets the free trial and the waiver)
the age group (Little Tigers 4 to 6, Kids 7 to 12, Teens and Adults 13 and up), from the parent's words; the AI passes only the age group
trained before: style and belt (sets beginner or sparring)
a membership to use, if they have one
away: a workplace, a school, a community center or a home, and how many people (and if children will be there)
after_time: what they hope for: fitness, confidence, focus or self-defense
away: the room, the way in, and who from the host stays in the room
secure_page_only: the student's first name and exact age
the parent's or guardian's yes that they may book and sign for the child
the waiver, read and signed, with a separate sparring line for sparring classes
health notes for the instructor (like asthma, a recent injury, or a head injury or surgery in the last 3 months)
the pick-up list: the adults who may take the child home
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult books for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs the waiver for them; a teen can't book alone (a link goes to a parent); away from the school, the host books, each adult who takes part signs their own waiver, and a parent signs for each child

stop.words: someone hurt or in danger right now
a child who talks about hurting themself
stop.say: Call or text 988, any time, or 911 if they're in danger now.
stop.booking: no booking in that chat (Rosie's always-on crisis rule); the parent can come back and book any time

go_on.what: not a danger on its own; the booking goes on, and it never goes in a text

go_on.words: asthma, a recent injury, a head injury or surgery in the last 3 months
go_on.what: the answer stays on the secure page; asthma with an inhaler books at once; a head injury or surgery in the last 3 months goes to Erin, the expert Sam named, to read first, and Erin may ask for a doctor's OK; Rosie gives no health advice

go_on.words: asks if sparring is safe, or when a child may spar
go_on.what: no advice from Rosie: the instructor answers; sparring only at the belt the school sets, with gear

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver
steps.when: before the first class, signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: the student if 18 or older; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18; away, each adult who takes part, and a parent for each child
steps.goodFor: 1 year (the example school's setting), or until the school changes it
steps.words: a risk notice and consent; where the state's rules don't allow a release, it's never called one
steps.result: signed: the booking goes on; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: Health notes, emergency contact and pick-up list
steps.when: on the secure page, with the waiver
steps.result: the booking goes on; a head injury or surgery in the last 3 months goes to Erin, the expert Sam named, to read first

steps.name: Sparring line
steps.who: a parent initials it for a child
steps.result: not initialed: no sparring class is booked

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: come 15 minutes early for a first class, to meet the instructor; a T-shirt and sweatpants, bare feet, no jewelry, a water bottle; a uniform from the 3rd class; sparring gear for a sparring class; away, a clear space about 20 by 20 feet for 12 people (the instructor brings mats and pads)

staff.skills: kids' classes, sparring, self-defense, private lessons, belt testing; only black belts Sam names run belt tests; only instructors cleared for children teach them
staff.licenses_or_certificates: no person license for teaching martial arts or personal training unless the state's form names one
staff.supervision: helpers under 18 assist only with an adult instructor on the mat, and never count as one of the two adults
staff.who_oks: Erin, the expert Sam named, reads a trial with a head injury or surgery in the last 3 months; Sam OKs a new customer's private lesson, a class with too few students, every fee, every belt test invite, same-day on-site classes, and any quote over $500 (Pat too, for Lee Self-Defense)
staff.stand_in: a sub instructor with the same clearance takes the whole class; everyone booked is told and may cancel with no fee

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult books for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs the waiver for them; a teen can't book alone (a link goes to a parent); away from the school, the host books, each adult who takes part signs their own waiver, and a parent signs for each child
children_and_age.minors_texts: every text about a child goes to the parent or guardian who booked, never to the child
children_and_age.minors_rules: a parent or legal guardian books and signs for anyone under 18; a child's data kept to what the class needs: first name, age, health notes, emergency contact and pick-up list

visit.check_in: at the school: each student's check-in code at the front desk (a parent gives it for a child), or the desk ticks names on the class roster; away: the host's code at the door or the meeting spot
visit.done: the check-in code or the roster tick; away, the code at the start, or DONE from the instructor
visit.changes_at_visit: an add-on (15 one-on-one minutes) is priced and OK'd first; an instructor change is texted to everyone booked, with a free cancel

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: from the state form: teaching martial arts and self-defense usually needs no state license; some states register schools or clubs that sell memberships, and may ask for a bond for months paid ahead; personal training needs no license unless the state's form names one
license.who: the business, for any registration or bond
license.ask: the school's or the company's registration number, where the state's form asks for one
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks; a company, a school or a building may ask for proof before an on-site class
license.background: a switch from the state's form: where the state requires background checks for adults who work with children, each instructor's check is asked for (who ran it, and the date) and shown as the school's word, never as checked by Rosie

never_in_a_text: a child's age, health notes, injuries, incident notes and anything about bullying or behavior never go in a text or through the AI; texts to the owner or staff carry none either, only the first name, the last initial and a link to the secure page
